## 分诊定级(R+69):**晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`

`finding` 摘除(定级即离标)。落点 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `coveringKey` docblock。

**Bug 判据**:四个派生数字与同文件 `--self-test` 实测值全部不符,而 self-test **944 个用例全绿** —— declared ≠ actual,且没有任何东西比较这两者。

## 裁决:**删数字,指向运行**(⛔ 不是「把字面量 pin 住」)

卡有意不提修法,并**明确警告**了最诱人的那条:*"⛔ not 'pin the literals'. A bare integer pinned to prose reds on every legitimate tree change, which is how a gate gets its assertion weakened later."* 分诊完全同意,并据此裁定:

> **把四个数字从散文里删掉,改为一句「跑 `--self-test` 看实时值」;保留论证本身。**

依据是卡自己的读数:**结论没有动过** —— 集中度实测 **207/241(86%)**,散文说 **201/232(87%)**;拒绝第五个键的**理由**(precision、concentration、provenance-not-volume)完全不受影响。⇒ 会腐烂的是数字,不是论证 ⇒ **只删会腐烂的那部分**。

⛔ 三条禁令:
- ⛔ 不 pin 字面量(理由如上,卡已论证);
- ⛔ 不重开第五个键的拒绝裁定(卡明说不是);
- ⛔ 不把 self-test 改成断言散文 —— 那等价于 pin,只是换了个位置。

## ⭐ 这张卡的形状值得记名,它比「数字过期了」准得多

> **一个实时仪器和一段陈旧叙事住在同一个 docblock 里,而人读的是叙事那一半。**

pin 会重新推导并打印这些值,**⛔ 没有任何东西把它们和四行之上的散文比较** ⇒ 散文可以永远说 232 而运行说 241,门全程绿。

⚠️ **而且漂移是被独立记录过、没人处置的**:#13251 的正文(2026-08-29,早于今天所有运行)已经写着 *"the card's 228 was measured at `8b4156139f`, today's is 234"* ⇒ 这个数字**被记录为会动**,而 docblock 仍带着第三个值。**三天三个数:228 / 234 / 241。**

⭐ 最锋利的一句是卡的收尾,分诊逐字保留进派发令:

> `dispatch-gates` **正是那个「用推导取代手工维护清单」的工具**,而这条拒绝的论证之一就是「手工维护的数字面会腐烂」。**它先在自己身上烂了。**

## ⚠️ 派发前必做

卡诚实标注:**live 那一列是从 PR #13465 转述的,不是立卡席自己跑的**,并写下 *"⛔ Re-derive before acting."* ⇒ 派发令要求 dev **自己跑一遍** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`,用**自己的**读数改写,⛔ 不得照抄本卡表格里的 241/207/121 —— 那些数字到 dev 动手时同样会漂。

## ⏸ Held on a hot file — `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is in flight under #13448

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, R34, at card selection.
⛔ Not a dispatch, ⛔ not a re-grading. Recording the exclusion **with its expiry condition** so the next
reader does not have to re-derive it — and so nobody reads the `pm:queue` label as "dispatchable now".

Triage placed this card's landing site at **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`**. That file is being
edited right now by **#13448** (p1, `hintCovers` / `unreachableReason`), dispatched at 10:56Z.

⛔ Two cards editing one file in parallel is the contention this seat's serial queue exists to
prevent — and this pair is worse than the usual case: **#13448 moves verdicts** (its fix changes which
gate families a dispatch brief names), while this card is about **derived figures in a docblock that
have drifted from what the code computes**. ⇒ Landing them in parallel means this card would be
re-stating numbers against a denominator that #13448 is in the middle of changing. ⭐ Whatever figures
a dev measured today would be stale before the second PR merged.

### Expiry condition

**When #13448's PR lands.** ⇒ Then this card is dispatchable, and ⭐ it is *better* then than now: its
whole subject is docblock figures agreeing with the code, and #13448 will have just changed what the
code computes — so a re-derivation after it is the honest one, not merely the unblocked one.

⚠️ Whoever picks this up next: ⛔ do not inherit that judgement. Re-check #13448's state, and re-read
its landed diff before re-deriving the four figures — the count that matters is the one on the tree
this card will actually ship against.

卡一样的怀疑读我的措辞;卡里那一列 live 数字**是从 PR #13465 转述的、不是立卡席自己跑的**,卡自己写着
**⛔ Re-derive before acting.**

### Zone 1 — TRIAGE RULING(⛔ 不可重裁,照抄不译)

> **晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · type **`Bug`**。落点
> `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `coveringKey` docblock。
>
> **Bug 判据**:四个派生数字与同文件 `--self-test` 实测值全部不符,而 self-test **944 个用例全绿** ——
> declared ≠ actual,且没有任何东西比较这两者。
>

> > **把四个数字从散文里删掉,改为一句「跑 `--self-test` 看实时值」;保留论证本身。**
>
> 依据是卡自己的读数:**结论没有动过** —— 拒绝第五个键的**理由**(precision、concentration、

>
> ⛔ 三条禁令:⛔ 不 pin 字面量(*"A bare integer pinned to prose reds on every legitimate tree change,

> ⛔ **不把 self-test 改成断言散文 —— 那等价于 pin,只是换了个位置**。
>
> ⭐ 卡的形状值得记名:**一个实时仪器和一段陈旧叙事住在同一个 docblock 里,而人读的是叙事那一半。**
> pin 会重新推导并打印这些值,⛔ 没有任何东西把它们和四行之上的散文比较。
>
> ⭐ 最锋利的一句,逐字带进派发令:
> > `dispatch-gates` **正是那个「用推导取代手工维护清单」的工具**,而这条拒绝的论证之一就是「手工维护的
> > 数字面会腐烂」。**它先在自己身上烂了。**

### Zone 2 — PM 机制假设(⚠️ 须实测;⛔ 都不是裁决,尤其因为这张卡是我填的)

- **A2.1 — ⚠️ 三天三个数,而现在应该是第四个。** 卡记录 `228`(#13251 在 `8b4156139f` 测)→ `234` → `241`
  (#13465 转述),docblock 停在 `232`。⭐ **而 #13783 刚刚改了 `hintCovers`** ⇒ 你必须在**含 #13783 的树上**
  自己跑 `--self-test`,把四个数字**当场读出来写进 PR**。⛔ 不引用卡里的任何一个数,⛔ 也不引用我这一段。
- **A2.2 — ⭐ 我假设裁决的「删数字」在 #13783 之后仍是对的修法,⚠️ 而这值得你先确认一次。** 逻辑是:数字会
  腐烂、论证不会。⚠️ 但若你发现 **#13783 之后连论证也变了**(例如集中度不再成立、或第五个键的拒绝理由被新的
  覆盖行为动摇),**那是要报告的发现,⛔ 不是顺手改掉的东西** —— 重开那条拒绝裁定是明令禁止的。
- **A2.3 — 「指向运行」要指得准。** 删掉数字后,留下的那句话必须让读者**知道跑什么、看哪一行输出**。⚠️ 一句
  含糊的「运行 self-test 即可」等于把腐烂换成了含糊。⭐ 判据:一个没读过这个文件的人,照那句话能在一次运行里
  拿到那四个量。
- **A2.4 — ⚠️ 这是 docblock 改动,但 `--self-test` 仍必须跑并保持 944(或它今天的真值)。** ⛔ 不得因为
  「只改注释」跳过门禁族 —— 而且这个文件是**本循环自己的仪器**,它的 self-test 是我每次派发所依赖的东西。
- **A2.5 — ⛔ 不碰 `hintCovers` / `unreachableReason`。** 那是 #13448 刚落地的面。你的改动应当**只在
  `coveringKey` 的 docblock 里**;若你认为需要动别处,停手并报告。

### Zone 3 — 建议路线(可选,⛔ 不是指令)

同一个文件里已经有「把测量交给运行、把论证留在散文」的先例(#13448 刚落地的 `unreachableReason` 就给出了
**一句点名 `git ls-files` 调用、读者可自行复现**的理由)。⭐ 照抄那个形状:论证保留,数字换成一条可执行的取数
指令。

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first。⛔ Never `git stash`。⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`。⛔ Governed surface
(`docs/adr/**`、`.claude/**`、`skills/**`、`AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`)—— 停手并报告。⛔ 不改
`packages/spec/src/**`。⚠️ `scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`(#13478)与本轮 #13489 的普查面
在飞 —— ⛔ 不碰。`scripts/` 不发版 ⇒ `skip-changeset`,但**先查 `Check Changeset` 的实际结论**再贴标签。
改门禁脚本会同时触发该约定的义务与路径推导族 —— **两边都跑**。逐项按 GREEN / RED / NOT MEASURED 报告你**实际
看到的退出码**(⛔ 不经管道取)。restore 用**观察到的状态**证明,⛔ 不用退出码。

## ACCEPT — PR #13806, pending the four checks still running

Reviewed against the card's defect, ⛔ not against whether the numbers are now correct. Verifying reads are this seat's own on `origin/main` and the fetched branch head `af5103cf0`.

### Verified independently, ⛔ not taken from the report

| claim | this seat's check | result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| behaviour untouched | `git diff origin/main...FETCH_HEAD` filtered for added **and** removed lines that are not comment-or-blank | **both sets empty** — zero executable lines move |
| the four literals are gone | `grep -c` for `273` `232` `201` `118` on the branch file | **0 / 0 / 0 / 0** |
| the stale self-test count too | same for `944` | **0** |
| no competing claim on this file | repo's own `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` | **success** |
| the sweep gate is happy | `Type Check · source gates` (carries `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`) | **success** |

⭐ The comments-only result is what settles the risk here: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is the whole board's single-writer toolchain file, and a docblock card is no licence to touch its decision logic. That is now a mechanical fact rather than a promise — `hintCovers` and `unreachableReason` could not have moved.

### ⭐ The fix is better shaped than the card asked for

The card named four drifted figures. The dev measured that **the rot is wider** and then did the thing that is easy to get wrong: it split the numbers by whether anything re-derives them.

- The **four a run produces** → replaced by a pointer at the run, plus the four assertion sentences that print them with each quantity named in place.
- **Every other size** (the tail, the two narrowings, the lower-bound shapes, the witness's own family count) → ⛔ **not silently refreshed**. Dated to #13126's tree with an instruction to re-measure from that card's commands, matching the idiom the neighbouring aggregate paragraph already uses.

Silently refreshing that second class would have re-armed the identical defect on a slower clock. Handling it in place is accepted under the bounded-fix test: same docblock, same defect class, comments only, no new gate surface, and declared with evidence rather than slipped in.

⭐ And it declined the obvious wrong move with a reason worth keeping: *"Pinning them instead would red on every legitimate tree change, which is how an assertion gets weakened later."* ⇒ ⛔ the self-test was correctly **not** made to assert the prose. The run stays the instrument; the docblock keeps only the argument.

### Zone 2 outcomes

- **A2.1 extended, and it falsifies a figure in this seat's own card.** Re-derived on a tree carrying #13783: 245 novel of 286 pairs, 41 answered elsewhere, 211 of 245 on 5 modules, `invoked-as.mjs` fan-out 123 — and the self-test is **1048 cases, not the 944 this card quoted**. ⇒ the card's own instrument reading was stale as well; noted against this seat, not the dev.
- **A2.2 answered NO, with measurements**: concentration still 86%, worst lead grew 118 → 123 (which *strengthens* the precision argument), tail still the opposite shape, both narrowings still earn nothing. ⇒ the refusal is **not** reopened and the argument did not move.
- **A2.3** verified end-to-end by running the docblock's own recipe under `set -o pipefail` and capturing stdout — all four quantities from one run.

`check-test-completeness.mjs` exited **3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET**, no saved turbo log named. ⭐ Reported as a **missing input, not a red**, which is right: CI's Test Core job supplies that log. ⛔ Not counted as green either.
